cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `CMakeLists.txt` sets it for the `meson setup` command of the libfuse3 build.
cells.What Tron does with it: The configure command of the libfuse3 external project runs `meson setup` with `CXXFLAGS=-Wno-nonnull`. The assignment applies to that one command.

An install rule of the `Runtime` component creates the symbolic link `libfuse3.so.4` in `$DESTDIR<CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX>/lib`. `build-deb.sh` sets it to `<build-dir>/tron-host-stage` for one `cmake --install` command. It then expects the installed files under that directory.
The makefile of iotools (a third-party hardware register tool kept in `bin/iotools-1.5`) adds the text to `CFLAGS`. The rule that builds the `iotools` binary passes `CFLAGS` to the compiler.

cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `nix/cmake-tron-test-build.nix` exports it in the Nix build `tron-cmake-test-build`.
cells.What Tron does with it: The build phase of `tron-cmake-test-build` exports it as `ON`. No file in the checkout reads the environment variable.

cells.Where: The GHC runtime in `ingest` and `ingest-tests` (`ingest/tron-ingest.cabal`). No Tron source line reads it.
cells.What Tron does with it: The cabal comments name it as the way to override the built-in GHC runtime options of the `ingest` executable and of the test suite `ingest-tests` at run time.

It marks a run inside the Nix dev shell. CMake takes `python3` from `PATH`. `rust/run-cargo` requires `TRON_NIX_RUST_TOOLCHAIN` and uses that Rust toolchain. `make deb` and `make deb-host` stop with an error.
The value counts only with `STATIC=0`. Then `make` adds it to `CFLAGS` of the `iotools` program. Otherwise the makefile assigns `-static` and the environment value is not used.

cells.Where: `make` in `bin/iotools-1.5` (`bin/iotools-1.5/Makefile`). `flake.nix` sets it for the build tools of the Nix dev shell.
cells.What Tron does with it: On Linux, `flake.nix` sets `-lgcc_s` in the Nix dev shells. A source comment says that `libgcc_s` gives the unwinding symbols for builds with `--rtlib=compiler-rt`. The iotools makefile adds the value to its link command.

cells.Defined by: LLVM build system (a CMake option there)
cells.Where: Nothing in Tron. `CMakeLists.txt` sets it in the environment of the CMake configure step.
cells.What Tron does with it: The root `CMakeLists.txt` sets `16` in each configure run in which `check_ipo_supported` reports that link-time optimization is supported. It then replaces a value from the caller.
The recipes that start a nested `make` run this command. Examples are the goals `format`, `coverage-report` and `ingest-coverage`.
The makefile reads the goals while it parses, for example to refuse `make deb` inside the Nix dev shell. It exports the variable to its recipes. Slice then labels its Dice work `make <goals>`.

The makefile appends `--no-print-directory -j $(NPROC_BUILD)`. For a remote build (a build that `bin/bsub-build` submits to an LSF worker), `-jN` sets `REMOTE_BUILD_CORES` to N. The flag `-B` goes to the worker too.
